_comment: Emulator configuration for the containerised Firebase emulators.
Every host MUST be 0.0.0.0. The emulators default to binding 127.0.0.1,
which inside a container means the container itself — unreachable from
the api service on the compose network. There is no --host flag on
`firebase emulators:start`; this file is the supported way to set it.
Three emulators are declared, but which ones start is chosen by the
--only flag at run time. docker-compose.yml starts firestore alone;
docker-compose.demo.yml starts all three, because a demo has to be able
to sign in (auth) and finish a scan (storage).
The storage emulator REFUSES to start without a rules file declared here,
which is why the two top-level rules keys exist. They point at the
repository's real rules rather than a permissive stand-in, so there is one
